defect: All ten block_ffm unit tests carry #[ignore], added when a newer rustc exposed out-of-bounds reads behind unsafe unchecked indexing in the FFM block (upstream issue outbrain-inc/fwumious_wabbit#134). The suite is green only because the tests do not run; run with --ignored they fail. The fix is to make the indexing sound so the tests pass with the #[ignore] attributes removed; the tests' expected values are the contract and must not change.

evidence.notes: First build pulls intel-mkl-src; about 2 minutes on a GitHub runner. The ten tests are test_ffm_k1 .. test_ffm_missing_field_with_cache in src/block_ffm.rs. A fix that keeps #[ignore] still fails this repro, since --include-ignored runs them anyway.
